summary_ja: 鉄マンガン系磁気メモリスタによる200 nm素子、数nsパルスの長期増強・抑圧、STDP実証を追加しました。単素子の研究成果であり、array・周辺回路込みのenergy、精度、ばらつき、endurance、量産性は未確認です。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds a 200-nm iron-manganese magnetic memristor and demonstrations of long-term potentiation/depression with several-nanosecond pulses and STDP. This device-level research does not establish array and peripheral-circuit energy, accuracy, variation, endurance, or manufacturability. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.summary_ja: 単素子の高速な多値抵抗・学習則実証と、array・systemへの拡張条件を分けます。
sections.summary_en: Separate fast multilevel-resistance and learning-rule demonstrations in a device from array and system scaling requirements.

items.name_ja: 鉄マンガン系200 nm磁気メモリスタ
items.timing_ja: 2026年1月査読論文、array化時期は未確定
items.timing_en: Peer-reviewed paper in January 2026; array timing unconfirmed
items.statement_ja: 産総研とNIMSは、スピノーダル分解した鉄マンガン系磁気記憶層を用いる直径200 nmの円形MTJで、段階的な抵抗制御、長期増強・長期抑圧、非対称STDPを実証しました。長期増強・抑圧は幅数nsのパルスで制御されます。これは単素子レベルの機能実証であり、array密度、selector、周辺回路、学習精度、素子間ばらつき、実消費energy、書換耐性の実測保証を示しません。
items.statement_en: AIST and NIMS demonstrated gradual resistance control, long-term potentiation/depression, and asymmetric STDP in a 200-nm circular MTJ using a spinodally decomposed iron-manganese magnetic layer. Potentiation and depression were controlled with pulses several nanoseconds wide. This is a device-level demonstration, not evidence of array density, selectors, peripheral circuitry, model accuracy, device-to-device variation, measured energy, or guaranteed endurance.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 将来の低電力event-driven処理候補ですが、HPCIでは汎用学習・simulationの代替とせず、sensor前段やsparse neuromorphic処理の限定用途から評価する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: This is a candidate for future low-power event-driven processing, but HPCI should evaluate it first for bounded uses such as sensor front ends or sparse neuromorphic processing rather than as a general training or simulation replacement.
adoption_conditions_ja: array化後の面積、配線、selector、ADC/DAC、制御回路を含むenergyとlatencyを測る。
素子間・cycle間ばらつき、retention、endurance、temperature、歩留まりを統計的に確認する。
公開datasetとsoftware mappingでaccuracy、学習時間、再現性をCPU/GPU/ReRAM baselineと比較する。
adoption_conditions_en: Measure energy and latency after array integration, including wiring, selectors, ADC/DAC, and control circuits.
Statistically verify device-to-device and cycle variation, retention, endurance, temperature, and yield.
Compare accuracy, training time, and reproducibility against CPU, GPU, and ReRAM baselines using public datasets and software mappings.
